description:
Current incident state for one named service.

Returns the normalised state (operational, degraded, down, unknown), the provider's own description, and a link to the full status page. Use when you already know which provider you care about.

service.description: Slug of the service to check. One of: github, npm, cloudflare, anthropic, openai, vercel, netlify, render, supabase, mongodb, digitalocean, docker, circleci, sentry, datadog, twilio, atlassian, bitbucket, discord, hashicorp.

name: check_service_status
title: Check Service Status
